main_text.p: Significabat continuam & spiritualem lætitiâ sub Euangelio, cum cantu & gratiarum actione resonantem. Esa. 35.2.3. 10. & 48.20.21. & 49.13.14. & 52.9.
Festum expiationis, erat dies decimus mensis septimi,ad animas ieiunio slato affligendas. Leu.17. 29.30.31.Heb.29.7.
Proprius huius festi cultus erat, vnčti sacerdotis opus ad sanctuarium sacrum, tentorium conuentus, altare, sacerdotes ipsos, & totum populum expiandum.Leu.16.32.33.34.
Significabat ecclesiasticos conuentus, administros & populum in cultu quotidiano peccantes, per Christum quotidie expiari.
Ex festi tabernaculorum significationis analogia, & Leu.17.16.inter se comparatis.

Rerum præparatio erat, vt pro ipso acceptis iuuencis subrumis in peccatum, & arietem in holocaustum,acciperet etiam duos hircos e capris in peccatum,& arietem vnum in holocaustum,& ratione sequenti pararet,Num.16.5.6.7.
Ea autem ratio erat,vt hircos Iehouæ ad portum tentorij conuentus sisteret, & duabus fortibus hircis impositis,vna pro Iehoua, altera pro Hhazazele, id est,capri profectione.Num.16.7.8.

page.notes: The diagram's brace structure is read from the drawing: "Huius cultus duo membra" branches into "Rerum præparatio specialis" (Leu. 16. 3. 5. 8. 9.) and "Applicatio specialis" (15.16.&c.), with "specialis" and "10. 11. 12. 13. 14." as the middle entries. The text at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. Right margin fragments (mur, exie, fang, pon, fang, tant, catis) are cut off by the scan edge and are not legible enough to transcribe. The word "Applicatio" is set right-aligned in the text block and is treated as a paragraph, not a catchword.
